title: CPP-5: Replace raw CloseHandle/new/delete with WIL/std RAII in hotspots

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: A separate detached, pristine local checkout is prepared at the exact upstream head. The live-base patch contains the intended thirteen paths and matches the fork comparison's patch despite the fork's newer base. The dirty shared checkout was preserved. Installed x64 tools and required global-cache package versions are present, but the isolated local checkout lacks its CppWinRT/WIL packages tree and static-triplet native installation. Presence in a shared installation does not establish baseline or ABI compatibility. Isolated dependency provisioning and compatibility verification remain prerequisites before the first CommonUtils build and focused tests. No restore, build, test or shared-root dependency use occurred; full review remains incomplete.
